title: Ever Works — Skills Catalog Manifest (manifest.json)
description: Index of the Skills catalog. One row per skill folder under skills/. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard (agentskills): a directory containing SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter + Markdown body) plus optional references/, scripts/, assets/. The platform reads this manifest from the default branch and resolves each row's skillPath to load the SKILL.md. license + sourceUrl are MANDATORY on every row for provenance.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

slug.description: Unique skill slug, kebab-case. Must equal the skill's folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the skill folder (e.g. 'skills/skill-creator').

summary.description: One-line description shown in catalog listings.

skillPath.description: Repo-relative path to the SKILL.md the platform loads (e.g. 'skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md').

version.description: Catalog-row semver for this skill entry.

license.description: Exact SPDX license identifier of the upstream source (e.g. 'Apache-2.0', 'MIT'). MANDATORY.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical URL of the upstream source the skill was seeded from. MANDATORY.

licensePath.description: Repo-relative path to the per-folder LICENSE.txt, when the upstream ships one (Apache-2.0 sources).
